scope: Proposition 7.1 (Boundary crossings) of the manuscript “Uniform marked-polygon estimates and sharp finite bridge moments” (preprints/Uniform-marked-polygon-estimates-and-sharp-finite-bridge-moments-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e9b7a0252f329287), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a fixed boundary port of a convex pure-sided tiled domain, including a straight strip or half-plane by exhaustion, the critical mass of completed paths with diameter at least r is at most C(1 + r)−1/4. In a pure half-plane the mass Kl between two boundary ports at lattice distance l ≥ 1 is decreasing in l and satisfies Kl ≍ l−5/4. All constants are independent of the domain and the chosen port.
